original_boundary: The raw PlanetWndProc calls FLookupOrbitingXfer(sel.pl.id, selected_ordinal, &_Stack_a6, -1). Button 0 forwards the returned id/grobj to TransferStuff with mode 1; button 1 forwards the id only when grobj is 2. The typed callback preserves that consumer boundary while the packed fixture asserts the shared FLookupOrbitingXfer record layout.
